name: Scan Confirmation
summary: Scan Confirmation — prove a fix (or a finding) with Tenable's own scan. Give plugin IDs and assets (IPs, asset UUIDs or a tag); it plans the smallest set of `navi scan create` scans (one plugin each, chunked targets, scanner + credential), runs every preflight check, then — only after you confirm — launches them, streams every navi command into the live CLI window, polls each scan to the end, runs a scoped sync (`--since` for state changes plus `--days 1` for still-open findings) and gives one verdict per asset × plugin: confirmed fixed, still vulnerable, not vulnerable, newly found, inconclusive (no login), not assessed or pending. Deterministic — no model anywhere. Launching is triple-gated (writes + NAVI_SCAN_LAUNCH + confirm); runs, scans, verdicts and a hash-chained event log live in tag_jobs.db. ⚡ One-off scan: a new scan with a saved policy (or the policy an existing scan uses) or plugin IDs, or a re-run of an existing scan — launch and watch, no verdicts.
